name: Favorite Categories
author: hardlysleeping
description: Mark categories as favorites (or pinned) and filter the sidebar and main stream down to them — or to everything except them — from one button. Choose a star or a pushpin glyph and matching wording. Pinned categories sort to the top and are tagged, with their original order restored when unpinned. Feed visibility is never touched outside Strict mode. Works alone or alongside a category-hiding extension.
